business_problem: Baogang needed better ways to inspect steel quality, accumulate production data, and optimize steel-ladle operations because manual inspection and fragmented production intelligence made it hard to reduce energy use, improve safety, and support process decisions.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud worked with Baogang Technology on the 'Smart Ladle' program, which combines cloud infrastructure, IoT, and industrial analytics to support steel production decisions. Internal system and ladle-equipment data is uploaded into Baidu's cloud platform, where the Tiangong IoT Platform and Tiansuan big-data platform supply the data-processing base. On top of that base, analytics are applied to safety warning, precise converter tapping-temperature control, production scheduling optimization, repair scheduling optimization, and broader support for refined production, equipment safety, energy reduction, and supply-chain decisions. The case positions the project as more than a monitoring dashboard: it is a perception-to-decision platform that connects data collection, storage, computing, understanding, and operational guidance.

solution_components.name: Tiangong IoT Platform
solution_components.role: Connects internal systems and ladle equipment data into the industrial decision platform.

solution_components.name: Tiansuan Big Data Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the data-processing foundation for warning, scheduling, and optimization analytics.

solution_components.name: Smart Ladle
solution_components.role: Acts as the operating application for ladle safety warning, temperature optimization, and production-decision support.

data_flow: Operational data from Baogang's internal systems and ladle equipment flows into the Tiangong and Tiansuan stack, where analytics models evaluate safety, temperature, production, and maintenance scenarios. The resulting outputs support scheduling, energy-saving decisions, and refined production management.
business_outcome: Baogang used industrial cloud and analytics to improve steelmaking decision support, reduce energy consumption, strengthen safety warning, and create a clearer data path for intelligent manufacturing upgrades.
metrics: Average tapping temperature was reduced by 10°C.
Energy costs could be reduced by 7 billion RMB.
Ladle optimization could save about 15 billion RMB annually.
